title: Magnetic Flux
keywords: Collects nearby item entities into the inventory directly below it using an eight-slot filter

blocks.text: Collects nearby item entities into the inventory directly below it using an eight-slot filter.

rows: Put representative items in filter slots.
Choose whitelist/blacklist and item/tag versus component matching.
Place a receiving inventory underneath and remove a disabling redstone signal.

blocks.text: An entity remains in the world when transfer is blocked. Filter mode, range or a full inventory can explain no collection.

Read the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.
